arcs.title: The Biscuit Tin Endgame
arcs.summary: Day 1: In the centenary edition, Lucy has ostentatiously granted one incident-free day — which has caused the household to grow suspicious rather than relieved. The biscuit tin, last noted in four consecutive fixed positions, has now been returned to a fifth position: dead centre on the counter, perfectly aligned, which no one did. Household analysts have described this as 'the most troubling development yet.' Lucy was observed sitting three feet away, looking at the ceiling. Day 2 should escalate: either a biscuit goes missing with no trace whatsoever (Lucy's masterwork), or the tin is found in a location that should be physically impossible, or a second household object is found suspiciously well-placed, suggesting a longer and more strategic campaign than anyone had previously imagined.
